skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn my photos into a smooth HD video with transitions — and get HD video...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video HD — Convert Photos into HD Video.

- Instantly converts uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB) into smooth HD videos with transitions.
- Cloud-based rendering delivers 1080p MP4 files in 30–90 seconds—no local installation needed.
- Simple, guided setup with automatic token management and session creation.
- Includes built-in commands for upload, export, credits, and session status.
- Supports marketers and creators with an easy workflow—no video editing skills required.
